interpretation: The clean before/guard-only/final runs use the same camera, input sequence, full background rendering and 300-host-second ceiling; combat RNG was not seeded.
Rates describe the final sampled simulation interval, not display FPS, an average, or a controlled causal speedup.
Windows Responding and UI heartbeat do not prove acceptable playability or absence of all stalls.
All 6001 attackers and 600 defenders are simulated in live runs; only isolated fixtures freeze the army.
Ordinary Mandinga melee reaches guards; existing Toughness absorbs the tested 53 damage. No armor or damage rebalance was made.
Old active saves update groups at the existing 35-tic cadence; an inspection before that refresh can still see old uncapped membership.
Prototype fixture failures (early PostBeginPlay reads, moving dummy, rat reach, absent event handler in old saves) were corrected and rerun; they are not final product failures.
Midflight/chair/idle save reload and old-save migration preserve state. Rollback loads the preserved original save with the original package; new-save downgrade is not claimed.
Earlier expanded-layout geometry evidence remains applicable because the map is byte-identical; remaining end-to-end and author checks are separate.
